issues.description: Function simulate_msd_two_rounds has inconsistent parameter lists across artifacts. The problem statement (and the reference solution) declare simulate_msd_two_rounds with three parameters: (n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) but the template defines simulate_msd_two_rounds only with two parameters: (n_shots: int, p: float). This mismatch will confuse or block students because tests or example usage that rely on an explicit batch_size parameter (or that call the function with three arguments / keyword argument batch_size) will fail against the template API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template signature match the problem statement and reference implementation by adding the batch_size parameter with the same default: def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]: and update the function docstring accordingly. Alternatively, if batch_size was not intended, update the problem statement and solution to use the two-argument signature consistently.
